Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Indian players are in huddle just near the boudnary ropes where Hardik Pandya is giving a pep talk. Now they spread out to take their respective field positions. Finn Allen and Devon Conway are the two openers for New Zealand. Hardik Pandya to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India have posted a mammoth total on the board and will be confident enough of defending this and win the series. New Zealand, on the other need something really special to chase this down and for that they will need a good start in the Powerplay. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

New Zealand, on the other hand, will be very disappointed with their bowling effort here. Michael Bracewell once again gave them an early breakthrough, but they could not build on that. They had no answers for the Indian batters, especially Shubman Gill, who took them apart and spared no one. They came up against a special player in this game and will  need to give credit to Gill. Blair Tickner, Daryl Mitchell and Ish Sodhi were the other bowlers who picked up a wicket each. Mitchell was great under pressure as he conceded just six runs in the final over to give a small victory for the Kiwis.

India has put on a show here for their fans. They came out with intent, and that reflected on their performance. They did lose Ishan Kishan early, but that did not bother them. Rahul Tripathi and Shubman Gill steadied the ship with a 80-run partnership, with the former setting the tone with a quick-fire 44 off just 22 balls. SKY came in and continued the momentum before getting out. Gill, on the other hand, held one end and scored his maiden T20I fifty before going hammer and tongs with Hardik Pandya on the other end. Both of them added 103 runs for the fourth-wicket. Gill went berserk at the fag end of the innings and registered his maiden T20I hundred as well and remained unbeaten on 126 runs off just 63 balls which is also the highest individual score by an Indian in this format.

Take a bow, Shubman Gill! He has shown everyone that he belongs in this format as well with an incredible hundred. He becomes the fifth Indian to score a ton in all three formats. This is also the highest total by any team against New Zealand in this format. In the last game, we saw 200 being scored in almost 40 overs, and here India have managed well beyond that in the first innings itself.
No, he cannot! Nonetheless India do end up wth a big score. It is full, outside off. Deepak Hooda strokes it through covers for a single. India end their innings at 234/4.
Goes full, outside off. Gill drills it down the ground for a single. Can Deepak Hooda end it with a biggie?
WIDE! Full, angling across, outside the tramline. Wide called.

A slower bouncer, outside off. Gill tries to go for the upper cut but misses. There is a stifled appeal for caught behind and New Zealand take the review. The UltraEdge later confirms that there is no bat involved.

Full and on off. Gill smacks it hard back to the bowler. Daryl Mitchell gets a hand on it but parries it to mid on. Gill calls for the second run and they make it safely in the end as the throw is wayward.
Deepak Hooda pulls this short ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Deepak Hooda walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Daryl Mitchell comes around the wicket. A length ball, outside off, angling across. Hardik Pandya stands tall and lofts it down the ground. It goes to long off off the toe-end. Michael Bracewell takes a sharp catch in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Daryl Mitchell

Commentary.Commentary: Daryl Mitchell to bowl the last over.
SIX! Shubman Gill continues on his merry way. It is short and on off. Gill stands back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. The stand moves to 103 runs.
FOUR! Smacked! Fuller, on off. Gill stands tall and drills it down the ground for four runs.
Another single now as this is worked to the off side.

Michael Bracewell almost pulls off a spectacular catch. It is full, on middle. Gill lofts it towards long on. Bracewell rushes to his left, he covers a lot of ground, puts in a dive to that side but fails to grab it. One taken.
FOUR! Deft touch. Benjamin Lister goes for the wide yorker, but it comes out like a low full toss, on sixth stump. Gill guides it down to third man for four runs.
Benjamin Lister fires in a yorker, on middle. Hardik Pandya whips it to deep square leg and crosses.
Benjamin Lister (3-0-25-0) to bowl the penltimate over.
A single to end an expensive over by Lockie Ferguson. 18 runs off the over. This length ball is played down to long on.
SIX! EDGY! Length ball, on off. Hardik Pandya looks to flick it to the leg side but it flies off the outside edge over the third man fence for a maximum.
Short and on off. Hardik Pandya pulls it to the leg side but not in the gap.
A single now as this is smacked down the ground.
SIX! HUGE! This is a length ball, on middle and leg. Gill smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 200 up for India!

FOUR! HUNDRED FOR GILL! Shubman Gill is in some incredible form currently. He becomes only the fifth Indian player to score a century across all formats. It is full, outside off. Gill lofts it over extra cover. It takes a couple of bounces over the ropes.
Lockie Ferguson (3-0-36-0) is back on.
FOUR! Beats the fielder. It is a low full toss, on off. Hardik Pandya smacks it over mid off and it races away.
WIDE! Blair Tickner spills it outside the tramline. Pandya makes the leaves and the umpire signals a wide.
Very full, outside off. Gill stabs it to point and crosses.
The ball has taken some hitting and the umpires have decided to change it now.
SIX! BANG! Shubman Gill races away to 96 runs. Back of a length, on middle. Gill stands tall and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
It is a length ball, on off. Gill almost lobs it back to the bowler but it lands safely.
WIDE! This is spilled way outside off, over the tramline. Wide called.
FOUR! Smart shot. It is very full, wide outside off. Gill reaches out and dabs it down to third man for four runs.
SIX! Is there any way to stop Gill here? This is so effortless. Shubman Gill is only dealing in sixes here. It is overpitched, outside off. Gill smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie..
Blair Tickner (2-0-27-1) comes back into the attack now.
Benjamin Lister ends the over on a positive note. It is very full, outside off. Hardik Pandya tries to chase it but misses. 14 runs off the over.
Full length, on off. Gill slices to deep point for a single. Lockie Ferguson is caught in two minds in the deep.
SIX! This one is even better. It is full again, on the pads. Gill wrists it powerfully over the square leg fence for a maximum.
SIX! High and handsome! This time Gill connects and sends it into the crowd. It is a full-length ball, on leg. Gill clears his front leg and tonks it over the mid-wicket fence.
Benjamin Lister dishes a wide yorker, Gill tries to reach out but misses.
Full length, attacking the pads. Pandya flicks it over mid on for one run.
Benjamin Lister replaces Lockie Ferguson.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Mitchell Santner fires this one in, on off, Shubman Gill stays there and slices it between point and short third man for a boundary.
Slower through the air, on middle, Hardik Pandya goes down and sweeps it towards deep square leg for one more.
Flatter, full and on off, Shubman Gill lifts it through covers for one.
Quicker, short and on off, Hardik Pandya slaps it towards long on for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Hardik Pandya stays there and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Short and on off, Shubman Gill forces it towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Hardik Pandya finds the gap now! This is short and around off, Hardik Pandya drags his pull shot wide of long on where Finn Allen runs to his right and dives, but fails to stop it from going to the boundary.
A low full toss, shaping away in the air, Hardik Pandya slashes but misses.

Overthrows! This is full and on off, Shubman Gill drives it towards mid off and refuses the run. Mitchell Santner has a shy at the bowler's end, but misses and there is no one backing up. A single is taken.
SIX! BOOM! Shubman Gill goes big now! Lockie Ferguson bangs this short and on off, slower too, Shubman Gill gets into position quickly and hammers it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Short of a length and on middle, Hardik Pandya gets a bit hurried and mistimes his pull shot towards deep backward square leg for a run.
This is on a good length and on off, Shubman Gill pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Short again and on off, Shubman Gill pulls it this time towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle, Hardik Pandya pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is full and on the pads, Hardik Pandya tickles it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary to get off the mark.
Hardik Pandya is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! New Zealand needed something special and Michael Bracewell has provided it to get rid of SKY. Blair Tickner serves this full and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav looks to slog it over mid on, but this time fails to get the timing right as his bat twists when he connects and hits it aerially wide of mid on. Michael Bracewell there moves to his right and puts in a full length dive to take a stunning catch. The umpires sends it upstairs to confirm the catch and the replays shows that it is clean. India three down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Is this a clean catch? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The soft signal is OUT. The third umpire is satisfied with the catch and the big screen shows OUT.
SIX! SKY at his best! Blair Tickner bowls this on a good length and on off, angling in, Suryakumar Yadav stays there and laps it over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Full and on middle, Shubman Gill clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A single to end the over as this short delivery is punched towards sweeper cover by Gill.
Another short delivery, on middle, turning away, Suryakumar Yadav cuts it towards cover-point where Daryl Mitchell dives but lets it through for one.

FIFTY FOR GILL! This is his maiden half-century in T20Is and he has looked in good touch. Now, he will look to make this big. Coming to the delivery, Santner bowls this quicker, on leg, Shubman Gill works it off the inner half towards short fine leg for a single.
Short again and outside off, Shubman Gill slaps it towards sweeper cover where a fumble allows the second run.
Shortish and on middle, Shubman Gill knocks it towards the bowler.
Angles this one into the batter, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav pushes it wide of covers where the fielder dives bit fails to stop it. They cross.
Darts this one full and on the pads, Suryakumar Yadav tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter in length and on leg, Suryakumar Yadav heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
SIX! BANG! SKY connects this time alright! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav goes down and slog-sweeps it well over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Floated, full and around off, Suryakumar Yadav goes for the sweep, but misses as the ball goes off his gloves to the off side. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW, but turned down.
A bit short and on the leg stump line, Shubman Gill moves back and pulls it towards deep square leg for single. He moves to 47 and this is now his highest score in T20Is.
Flighted, full and on leg, Shubman Gill misses his flick and gets hit on the pads as the bal goes nowhere.

Drinks break! India are scoring runs freely here even though they have lost two wickets. Rahul Tripathi set the tone with a quick-fire knock, while Shubman Gill is timing the ball nicely. This is nicely poised for SKY and other big hitters to come in and go hard to post a huge total. The Kiwis need a couple of wickets to break the momentum and get back in this game. An exciting second part of the innings awaits us.
This is an arm ball, drifting into the pads.Gill flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Loopy ball, on off, defended out solidly.
FOUR! Up and over! It is tossed up, full and on middle. Gill dances down the track and lofts it to long on for four runs.
BYE! Floated and full, outside off, turning away. Suryakumar Yadav tries to go for the sweep but misses. They cross for a bye.
Another single now! This fired into the pads. Gill nudges it to the leg side for one run.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Yadav flicks it past mid on for a single.
This is flicked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav gets his first boundary. Back of a length, outside off. Yadav goes back and slaps it towards deep point and gets a boundary.
A bit short, wide of off. Gill cuts it through point for a single.
On off, defended out to covers.
The number one ranked batter in T20Is, Suryakumar Yadav comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! An entertaining knock by Rahul Tripathi comes to an end. He is absolutely gutted here. He has to depart just six runs short of his half-ton. It is flatter and on middle. Rahul Tripathi pulls it behind square on the leg side. Lockie Ferguson sprints to his right and takes a solid catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lockie Ferguson b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BOOM! It is floated and full, outside off. Rahul Tripathi prods and smokes it over the wide long off fence.
Shubman Gill knocks this full ball to covers. A dot to end the over but the damage has already been done.
Full and on off. Rahul Tripathi knocks it down to mid on for a single.
On off, defended out.

SIX! Down the ground this time. Rahul Tripathi reaches his highest score here with 37 runs in ODIs. It is fuller, on middle. Rahul Tripathi charges down the wicket and dispatches it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
FOUR! Rahul Tripathi is scoring for fun here. It is a length ball, on leg. Rahul Tripathi shuffles and scoops it over short fine for a cracking boundary.
This is on leg, coming in with the arm. Gill flicks it past mid on and crosses.
Mitchell Santner brings himself into the attack now.
Quite short, on off. Rahul Tripathi waits for it and steers it down to third man. Two taken before the fielder cuts it out.
Drifting down leg. Gill nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Darted on the pads, Gill flicks it to wide of long on and collects a brace this time. These two are picking up the gaps well and running hard between the wickets.
Short, on leg. Rahul Tripathi swivels and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Very positive shot. It is tossed up, full and outside off. Rahul Tripathi leans in and lofts it over mid off. It races away.
Short ball, on off. Shubman Gill pulls it past mid on along the ground. One taken.
Ish Sodhi to bowl his leggies now.

DROPPED! How costly would this prove to be? Blair Tickner is the culprit here. It is a short ball, on off. Gill only manages to get a thick outside edge. The ball lobs behind short third. Blair Tickner gives it a chase but is unable to pouch it safely. One taken.
Length ball, tailing back in from outside off. Gill slashes at it but misses.
Lockie Ferguson goes very full attacking the stumps. Rahul Tripathi strokes it through cover-point for a single. With that, the 50-run partnership comes up between these two batters.
WIDE! A slower bumper, down leg. Rahul Tripathi leaves it alone for the keeper.
SIX! This is much better. Rahul Tripathi walks across and gets a maximum. It is very full, on middle. Rahul Tripathi shuffles outside off and paddles it over the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Short and punished. Ferguson pulls his length back, wide of off. Rahul Tripathi backs away and slaps it hard past point for a cracking boundary.
An inswinger, full and on off. Gill dabs it to the off side and races to the other end.
A slower one now, full and on off, Shubman Gill drives it towards extra covers for a single. 14 runs off the over!
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Blair Tickner lands this short and on off, Shubman Gill picks up the length early and hammers it over mid on for four more runs.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off, Shubman Gill blocks it back towards the left of the bowler.
FOUR! Glorious from Gill! This is full again and on off, Shubman Gill this time goes the other side and drills it past mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! You cannot bowl there to Gill, he will put it away everytime. Blair Tickner serves this full and on leg, Shubman Gill whips it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Blair Tickner begins with a yorker-length delivery, on off, Rahul Tripathi squeezes it towards third man for a single.
Change. Blair Tickner comes into the attack now.
Full again and on middle, Shubman Gill wrists it with great timing towards deep mid-wicket. Two runs taken!
Goes a touch fuller and on off, Shubman Gill knocks it towards mid off.
Short of a length and on middle, Shubman Gill clips it wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace.

Just over! Benjamin Lister bangs this short and on middle, Rahul Tripathi gets hurried and miscues his pull shot in the air. However, the ball falls just out of reach of the diving Finn Allen at square leg. They cross.
This is on a good length and on off, Rahul Tripathi steers it towards point.
Back of a length and on off, Rahul Tripathi initially thinks about working it away, but taps it towards backward point in the end. He wants the run, but is sent back and rightly so.
Change of ends for Benjamin Lister.
Length again and on off, Rahul Tripathi guides it towards third man for a run.
On a length and on leg, Shubman Gill misses his flick as the ball goes off his pads to the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is short of a length and on off, Shubman Gill stays there and gently dabs it wide of covers for a boundary.

Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a hard length, on middle, shaping in sharply, Rahul Tripathi skips down the track to cut it away, but gets squared and misses. Devon Conway behind the stumps does well to dive to his left and gets a hand to it. A bye is taken.
FOUR! Innovative and effective! This is full and outside off, Rahul Tripathi shuffles across and scoops it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Lockie Ferguson starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, on off, angling in, Rahul Tripathi gets hurried and the ball hits him high on his body and rolls to the off side.
FOUR! Great shot! Michael Bracewell bowls another short delivery, outside off, Shubman Gill makes room and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Short again and outside off, Rahul Tripathi moves back and pulls it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a run.
A bit short and on middle, Shubman Gill flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Rahul Tripathi goes for the sweep, but gets a top edge wide of backward square leg. They cross.
Rahul Tripathi walks in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Michael Bracewell draws first blood! Ishan Kishan once again falls to spin. Bracwell floats this one up, on middle, Ishan Kishan prods forward to defend, but plays down the wrong line as he expects turn and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW, and up goes the finger. Ishan Kishan takes the review after discussing with Gill. UltraEdge shows pad first and Ball Tracking indicates wicket's is umpire's call. The onfield call stays and Ishan Kishan has to make that long walk back.
Michael Bracewell begis with a flatter delivery, full and on off, Shubman Gill tucks it towards mid on for a single.
Michael Bracewell to bowl from the other end.
On a length and on middle, Shubman Gill nudges it towards mid-wicket and scampers across for a run.
FOUR! Shubman Gill gets off the mark in style! Benjamin Lister serves this fulland outsude off, Shubman Gill takes a stride forward and drives it well past mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length and on off, shaping away, Shubman Gill blocks it towards mid off.
BEAUTY! Benjamin Lister bowls this on a good length and in the channel outside off, angling away, Shubman Gill looks to play at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Ishan Kishan and India are underway! This is a touch fuller and outside off, Ishan Kishan steers it towards third man for a single.
A good start from Benjamin Lister! He begins with a hard-length delivery around off, shaping in, Ishan Kishan keeps it out to the off side.

The match is set to begin. The New Zealand players take the field. Followed by Shubman Gill and Ishan Kishan who will open for India. Benjamin Lister to start with the new ball. Will he have an instant impace into the side?

We are moments away from the game, but before that there will be a felicitaion ceremony for the India U-19 Women's Team for winning the T20 World Cup. This is a special moment for each and every member as Sachin Tendulkar is giving a speech to congratulate them.

Mitchell Santner, the captain of New Zealand says they would have bowled first. Adds that the wicket looks nice and they will need to take some wickets upfront to restrict India. Tells that the last game was tricky and 120 would have been enough. Mentions that playing in this stadium is exciting for the boys and this is his first time. Informs they have made one change as Benjamin Lister makes his debut in place of Jacob Duffy.

Hardik Pandya, the skipper of India informs that they will bat first. Mentions that the wicket looks fantastic and would like to get some runs on the board here. Adds that as a unit they have spoken about such situation, says winning and losing is a part of the sport and such knockout matches will surely help them a lot. Before heading back he says that Umran Malik comes in place of Chahal.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Devon Conway (WK), Mark Chapman, Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (C), Ish Sodhi, Lockie Ferguson, Blair Tickner, Benjamin Lister (On Debut & In for Jacob Duffy).

India (Playing XI) - Shubman Gill, Ishan Kishan (WK), Rahul Tripathi, Suryakumar Yadav, Washington Sundar, Hardik Pandya (C), Deepak Hooda, Shivam Mavi, Kuldeep Yadav, Arshdeep Singh, Umran Malik (In for Yuzvendra Chahal).
TOSS - The coin goes up in the air and lands in favour of Hardik Pandya. India have elected to BAT first.

PITCH REPORT - Ajit Agarkar is near the deck to inform us about the deck. He says there are some brown spots on the deck but it will get better with the grass present on the deck. Also says that the batters will have fun at this venue, unlike the other venues where they had to work hard. Wonder what changes both sides will make, keeping in mind the behaviour of this deck.

It will be a series decider in the third and final match of the T20I of New Zealand tour of India. Both sides will look to produce their best performance and win the game. The home team will feel relieved after they have managed to level the series in the last game. The Indian bowlers received some criticism after the first game. With their most recent victory, the side gained momentum and will now try to win the series. The bowling staff has been one of the team's issues in the past, and they will be hoping for a strong performance from them. Shubman Gill will look for a good start in this game alongside Ishan Kishan. Suryakumar Yadav has been in exceptional form, and he will look to anchor the innings in the middle order. The bowlers used the conditions well in the last game, and the side will expect a good show in this game too. On the other hand, Mitchell Santner will feel upset with the performance of his batters in the last game. Finn Allen and Devon Conway have done well so far, and the side will expect a strong show from them in this game. Glenn Phillips has to score quick runs in the middle order along with Mark Chapman and Daryl Mitchell. The bowling attack is a bit weak for the side, and they will look to do well in this game. Santner must lead from the front and bowl good spells along with Ish Sodhi. Santner and his boys need to pull out a good show in this game and grab the series. The stakes are high as this game promises to be a cracker.
